title: Jeff Tang
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Jeff Tang is a member of the Orchard Elementary School District Board of Trustees in California. He assumed office on January 1, 2019. His current term ends on December 11, 2026.
Tang is running for re-election to the Orchard Elementary School District Board of Trustees in California. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
